integrity: Exact-rational finite-state CTMC recurrence checked at 30 parameter/count configurations; infinite family established by written mathematical proof rather than exhaustive computation.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous static cycle, conditional first outbreak size, permanent immunity, Markovian edge infections and recoveries; not an empirical forecast. Qualitative immunity-localization effect is established prior art; new claim concerns quantitative finite-size polynomial and scaling, subject to unindexed-equivalent literature risk.
title: Exact cycle-localization penalty for infection-derived versus random immunity
